audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Abigail’s rainy-lake scene, Maru’s nighttime telescope scene, Linus’s Wild Bait lesson, and MarILDA’s negative-response explanation branch. Every spoken line, player response, poetic image, astronomy term, friendship statement, bait joke, recipe message, robot argument, and gender branch was reviewed in full event context with consistent direct Ukrainian Wild Bait and binary-star terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, forks and response IDs, recipe reward, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Mountain records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
